observations: Root ordered second reading, whole and both actual halves before image-first observations/text-open receipt. All15 fresh audit crops were personally viewed. Every word, accent, punctuation, mathematical letter/index, product, quotient slash, topology sign, arrow, underline and editorial state was compared with the consolidated page. The square was checked corner by corner and label by label: R,X/X,X with pr1 o v, pr2 o v and two p labels; the surprising lower-right X is unequivocal and retained. The absent multiplication cross in the last quotient of10.7 and absent tel que after i>=j are also retained. The first composition oval remains uncertain as to typographic o/circle; the cancelled du, cancelled formula after soient, lower projection-arrow head and clipped right-edge deletion remain unresolved after enlargement. The handwritten acute and apostrophe in d’équivalence are visible. Top4 and bottom35 have separate manuscript/archival roles; the archival comment is added to inventory. No textual change is justified; no context or mathematical proof check was used.

accent.first_words_or_objects: handwritten acute over typed e and apostrophe in d’équivalence
